## About this website

This site is the syllabus for *Introduction to Digital Humanities*. It is built with
[Quarto](https://quarto.org/), kept in a public [Git
repository](https://github.com/DHBern/introduction-to-dh/) and published automatically with
GitHub Pages — the same workflow you learn in Session 6 and use for your own
[assignment](/contents/assignment.qmd). If you want to see how a page here is made, use the
**Edit this page** link in the right-hand margin.

Corrections, dead links and suggestions are welcome as
[issues](https://github.com/DHBern/introduction-to-dh/issues/new/choose) or pull requests.

### Course materials

Readings, scans and any material that cannot be published openly are in the [ILIAS course
space](https://ilias.unibe.ch/ilias.php?baseClass=ilrepositorygui&cmdNode=yv:ng&cmdClass=ilObjCourseGUI&ref_id=3733960),
accessible to enrolled students.
